strings.zh: ⋯⋯啊啊我们是连{NEWLINE}哭泣的孩子都吓得住嘴的火箭队！{NEWLINE}为了顺利重建组织,{NEWLINE}经过３年的努力,{NEWLINE}现在在此做出火箭队的{NEWLINE}复活宣言！{NEWLINE}坂木大人！听得到吗？{NEWLINE}⋯⋯终于成功了哦！{NEWLINE}老大哪去了？{NEWLINE}能听到这个节目吗⋯⋯{NEWLINE}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯
strings.en: ...Ahem! We are Team Rocket, so{NEWLINE}feared that even crying children shut{NEWLINE}up! After 3 years of hard work to{NEWLINE}rebuild our organization, we hereby{NEWLINE}declare Team Rocket’s revival!{NEWLINE}Boss Giovanni! Can you hear us?{NEWLINE}...We finally did it!{NEWLINE}Where could the boss have gone?{NEWLINE}Can he hear this broadcast...?{NEWLINE}...... ...... ......
